node.statement: Under the root hypotheses and the earlier choices B = sum_j b_j, G = sum_k c_k, beta = (sum_j b_j*beta_j)/B, and m = B - G, the identity used here follows directly: multiplying q = (sum_j b_j*p_j - sum_k c_k*r_k)/m by m gives m*q = sum_j b_j*p_j - sum_k c_k*r_k, while m*beta = (B-G)*beta = sum_j b_j*beta_j - sum_k c_k*beta; subtracting these two displayed equations gives m*(q - beta) = sum_j b_j*(p_j - beta_j) + sum_k c_k*(beta - r_k).
